notes.title: Version 1.6 Some Bug Fixes
notes.content: Hello Vyankers here is the most updated version of the game. We fixed small bugs that some testers detected in the last version, hope you have fun.

notes.title: Version 1.3 online! Some bug fixes.
notes.content:
Hello Vyankers, in this version we fixed some small bugs that could bother some players in very specific situations and improved some game animations. It was a simple but important update so that new players can have an excellent experience with the game.

Thank you to everyone who purchased a copy of our first game and we hope you have an incredible journey rescuing the memories of Vyanka.

notes.title: Changes after community feedback
notes.content:
Hello Vyankers, we have an update to make life easier for players who suggested changes to the game's final boss. Now an angelic power will eliminate part of the threat of the final boss, making it easier for players to defeat him.

In addition, we have fixed some simple bugs related to the final boss and we have also removed an exploit from the game. Sorry to speedrunners, but a skill in the game that allowed you to pass through walls has been reworked and now you will no longer be able to skip some scenarios.

notes.title: Menus, Improved Dash and Achievements!
notes.content:
Hello, dear Vyankers! We’re here with an update addressing some bugs and quality of life improvements.

Shop menus on gamepads will no longer activate character abilities, and the map bug that prevented double jumping has been fixed.

We're working to ensure that the Enhanced Dash functions correctly and does not cause instant death if it ends on an enemy. We hope this issue is resolved and look forward to your feedback.

Some achievements had incorrect code in the initial release, but we’ve made the necessary fixes so they should now unlock properly. If any achievements still aren’t unlocking, please report them in the forum for future patches.

Thank you for playing our beloved Vyanka’s Memories, and may you help our heroine recover her memories!
